children: Chile's Cochilco on Friday raised its forecast for average copper prices to $6.18 per pound in 2026 and $5.95 per pound in 2027, citing constrained mine supply and a refined copper market with little room to absorb production disruptions.
Cochilco also forecast Chilean copper production will fall 8.4% in 2026 to 4.94 million metric tons before recovering 3% in 2027 to 5.08 million metric tons.
